summary: Add dependency-cruiser rules for flat TypeScript package boundaries and verify allowed and forbidden imports across every importer root.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.
Audited source template retained; target-specific adaptation and isolated enforcement tests required before installation claims.

deltas.reason: Establish flat packages, entrypoint conventions, tests, and cycle scope before installing a policy.
deltas.tradeoff: Less automatic than choosing src/packages from directory presence.

deltas.reason: Scan app and other importer roots so configured boundaries can actually observe violations.
deltas.tradeoff: The graph may be larger and reveal more preexisting issues.

deltas.change: Treat the template as adaptable code
deltas.reason: Account for five rules, regex root handling, tsconfig, and resolution rather than promising a one-variable edit.
Test distinct app, cross-package, test, fixture, and cycle behaviors instead of one illegal test import.
deltas.tradeoff: More setup work, justified by materially different rule paths.

deltas.reason: Use isolated fixtures or representative existing packages unless a committed example is useful.
deltas.tradeoff: The repository may lack the source default copy-me template.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.
